name: Electronic Display Interaction
description: BAS Display payload diagnostic and calibration experiment protocol.

steps.name: Approach Display Module
steps.guidance: Approach the payload console display screen.
steps.voice_alert: Please step up to the display module.

steps.name: Touch Screen Target
steps.voice_alert: Touch the display screen to initiate diagnostic test.

steps.name: Press Calibration Button
steps.guidance: Press hardware tactile switch to execute sensor calibration.

steps.name: Inspect Diagnostic Output
steps.guidance: Observe and inspect display values for verification.
steps.voice_alert: Inspect display telemetry to complete step.
